page.notes: Marginal notes on the right are reconstructed from a small, faint italic print: "S. q. 3." and "l. hum" are doubtful readings. The note "Suar. in opusc." is split across several lines of the scan and is placed as one note at its first line. The abbreviation "Refp." in the printed text is read as "Resp." (long s). The word "absti-neant" carries a printed hyphen at the line end; the first part of the word is hard to read and may be "abs-ti-" or "absti-". The page-number reads "391" in the printed head, which may be a little blurred.
